# Engineering Activity Journal

Chronological record of real development activities. Entries are written when work happens, not reconstructed later.

"Requested / decided / reviewed by user" is recorded separately from "generated by coding agent".

---

## E-001 — Repository audit and evidence-document setup

- **Date:** 2026-11-20
- **Task identifier:** E-001
- **Original request (user, verbatim intent):** "Before documenting anything: Inspect the complete repository structure. Understand the application architecture... Create a technical overview based on actual repository evidence. Do not assume that a feature exists just because its dependencies are installed."
- **Requirement:** Establish a truthful baseline before writing any interview evidence.
- **Investigation performed (agent):**
  - Listed all tracked files with `git ls-files`; inspected `package.json`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/layout.tsx`, `app/globals.css`, `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.gitignore`.
  - Checked `prd.md` size: 0 bytes.
  - Ran `npx shadcn@latest info --json` → no shadcn config, zero components.
  - Probed Postgres port 5432 (open), Docker daemon (not running), `psql` (absent), `gh` auth (authenticated, no remote).
- **Files created (agent):** `docs/engineering-evidence/*.md` (10 files), starting with `PROJECT_TECHNICAL_OVERVIEW.md`.
- **Key finding:** The project had **no backend, no database, no auth, no tests, and no product spec**. Any interview answer claiming otherwise would have been fabricated.
- **User decisions captured:** Use NestJS as the backend; keep documenting during coding.
- **Verification:** CLI output and file reads listed above. No code was executed against Postgres.
- **Limitations:** Database credentials were not tested in this entry. No application existed to test.

## E-002 — Frontend UI foundation: shadcn/ui initialization

- **Date:** 2026-11-20
- **Task identifier:** E-002
- **Original request (user):** "go use shdn ui skills" (use the shadcn/ui skill) and build all pages.
- **Requirement:** Establish a component foundation for the application UI.
- **Investigation (agent):** Loaded the `shadcn` skill; checked installed components first via `npx shadcn@latest info --json` (none installed).
- **Actions (agent):**
  - `npx shadcn@latest init --defaults --yes` → wrote `components.json`, `lib/utils.ts`, `components/ui/button.tsx`, updated `app/globals.css` and fonts.
  - `npx shadcn@latest add card input textarea label tabs badge table dialog alert select separator skeleton progress alert-dialog dropdown-menu sonner tooltip accordion scroll-area avatar empty` → 21 component files created; `button.tsx` skipped as identical.
- **Files changed:** `components.json`, `app/globals.css`, `app/layout.tsx` (font update by CLI), `lib/utils.ts`, `components/ui/*`.
- **API/database/auth changes:** none.
- **Verification:** CLI reported successful creation of the listed files; `button.tsx` was skipped because it already existed.
- **Bugs discovered:** none in the application. (Tooling note: the command shell strips PowerShell `$` variables, so inspection scripts had to avoid `$_`/`$matches`. This is an environment quirk, not an application bug.)
- **Remaining limitation:** Components are installed but no page uses them yet. The tooltip component's `TooltipProvider` wrapper has not been added to `app/layout.tsx` yet — tracked as ISSUE-003.
